image_description: A close-up view of a large whale breaching or surfacing in dark ocean water. The whale has a dark grey, mottled skin with white patches (barnacles/callosities) on its head and rostrum. Notably, there is a bright orange object attached to the side of the whale's body near the blowhole area, which appears artificial. The head shape is arched. No dorsal fin is visible, consistent with grey whales, but the posterior back is not fully clear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rostrum is clearly arched and the head profile matches the grey whale morphology. Blowholes are obscured by spray/angle but the general structure is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The characteristic mottling and white callosities/barnacle patches are clearly visible on the head and jawline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image frame cuts off before the posterior back where dorsal knuckles would be located. Only the anterior/mid-section is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows the robust, thick girth typical of a baleen whale.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed; baleen plates are internal and not visible in this external shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pectoral fins are submerged or out of frame; only the dorsal side of the body is shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture on the head appears rough and bumpy, consistent with callosities.
